reviews.title: Evolution and current state of robotic catheters for endovascular surgery: A comprehensive review
reviews.n_robots: 57 models in 130 versions (Sec. 2; PRISMA, Google Scholar, January 2011 to December 2023; 197 reports); includes Amigo, CorPath 200, CorPath GRX, Niobe with V-drive, Sensei X, Magellan, R-One, CathBot, ROSES, Althea (Figs. 5-6)
reviews.robot_pictures: none: every version is drawn as a pictogram table of its mechanisms (Figs. 4-6); no photograph or drawing of a robot (all 9 figures checked on the PDF, embedded images per page)
reviews.taxonomy_axes: mechanism classification of the leader (primary) and follower (secondary) units, actuation and feedback channels (Fig. 3: rollers, grab mechanism, spool; clamp rotation, whole-part rotation, sliding grips; conveyor belts, sliding rollers, differential; tip: pneumatic, magnetic, motor); per version: DoF, simultaneous translation and rotation, quick release, tip movement type, level of development 0-5 (3D model, phantom, animal, cadaver, human, commercial) (Sec. 4.3); ranges of motion and speed (Fig. 7); trueness and precision of translation and rotation (Fig. 8); correlation of mechanisms with these parameters (Fig. 9); problems and trends (Table 1)
reviews.commercial: yes, 7 in the timeline (Amigo, CorPath 200, CorPath GRX, Niobe with V-drive, Sensei X, Magellan, R-One)
reviews.actuated_tip: yes: tip movement type coded per version; specialized catheters in < 15 % of versions (tendon: Sensei, Magellan, FU, AT, QI, YI; precurved tubes COAST; pneumatic RO; shape-memory polymer HE; magnetic WO1.1) (Sec. 4.9)
reviews.magnetic: part: Niobe with V-drive and one magnetic tip (WO1.1); no other magnetic navigation system
reviews.simulation: no (one numerical error-compensation model mentioned, Sec. 6)
reviews.read_level: full (lit/txt + PDF, X1 2026-11-08); CC BY 4.0; supplementary material (Supplementary Methods, Supplementary Table 1, figure-reading notes) not downloaded

reviews.title: The Design of Endovascular Robots for Cardiac Interventions: A Survey
reviews.n_robots: 85 rows in Tables 1-15: 62 systems (11 commercial, 51 academic = 45 cardiac + 6 neurovascular) and 23 robotic tools (Sec. 2.2, p. 1917; abstract; Sec. 6)
reviews.robot_pictures: line drawings by one illustrator (Acknowledgments), no photographs: 52 of the 62 systems (Figs. 8-11, 13, 15-18, 21; not drawn: CorPath 200, Genesis RMN, Sensei X, Payne 2012, P. Zhang 2011, H. Liu 2017, L. Li 2018, Naudin 2019, LevshAi, T. Cao 2024; MicroVAST and ARMM share Fig. 21(d)) and 7 of the 23 tools (Fig. 19); drive mechanisms Figs. 12, 14; leader controls Fig. 22 (drawing style checked on PDF pp. 24 and 26)
reviews.taxonomy_axes: three control classes: proximal tip (passive), hybrid, distal tip (active) (Sec. 3); Tables 1-15 give the same 9 columns for all 85 rows: number of arms, DoF, tool manipulation principle, tool compatibility, human-machine interface, feedback, visualization, TRL (medical TRL of Rier et al. 2022); papers per system per year (Figs. 5-7); controls and visualization (X-ray, MRI, ultrasound, 3D) (Sec. 4); CorPath GRX field experience, reasons for low adoption, vision of collaborative 6-DoF robots that also change and assemble tools (Sec. 5)
reviews.commercial: yes, 11 (Amigo, CorPath 200, CorPath GRX, R-One, Niobe, Genesis RMN, Sensei X, Magellan, Navion, CGCI, Aeon Phocus; Tables 1, 11, 14)
reviews.academic: yes, 51 (Tables 2-10, 12-14; TRL3 for most, TRL5 for 11, TRL7 for Choi 2021, RVIR, REIS, ROSES)
reviews.actuated_tip: yes: 23 robotic tools (tendon: COAST, Qi 2019, A. Gao 2017, Y. Yan 2023; fluid pressure: MALICA, multi-actuator soft catheters, VINE; shape-memory polymer: He 2018, Mattmann; IPMC; peristaltic) and the pull-wire Sensei X and Magellan (Tables 11-15)
reviews.magnetic: yes: Niobe, Genesis RMN, CGCI, Aeon Phocus, Navion; MicroVAST, ARMM, Z. Yang 2021, Kim 2022, hybrid of Cha (OctoMag); magnetic tools (Tables 11-15)
reviews.simulation: excluded: vascular simulators and learning-based navigation papers excluded at screening (Sec. 2.2)
reviews.read_level: full (lit/txt + PDF, X1 2026-11-08); search: Scopus, no date limit, run October 2024, English only; 277 papers; data available from the corresponding author on request (Data Availability Statement)
